text:
DiSunno Architecture is a Hampton's based architectural design firm with a heavy focus on high end residential and commercial projects. 
You’ll work directly with our architects to develop design drawings, build Revit models, and prepare construction documents.
This is an in-person office position and we’re looking for someone with 1–3 years of architectural experience, strong Revit skills, proficiency in AutoCAD, and experience preparing construction documents. Candidates should be actively pursuing architectural licensure. 
If you are looking for an opportunity to join a dedicated and passionate team, position yourself for exciting growth and work in a comfortable and casual work environment with an excellent benefit package, we'd love to chat with you.
Please send resume, design and construction documentation to: [email protected]. View our work at disunnoarchitecture.com
